entities.summary: Kishane Thompson is a Jamaican track and field sprinter who competes in the 60 metres and 100 metres. He won the silver medal in the 100 metres at the 2024 Summer Olympics and 2025 World Championships, and over 60 metres at the 2026 World Indoor Championships.
